info.description: Self-hosted notifications where a dismissal on one device clears it on every device. See docs/SPEC.md.

503.description: A background job (snooze wake, prune) failed 3 times in a row; failing names it. Errors are in the server log.

404.description: Setup is finished (an admin token exists).

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: One-time setup code printed in the server log.

post.summary: Web sign-in: swap a token for a session cookie

303.description: Form post: redirect to next (default /app). A wrong token redirects there too, with error=token added to the query.

101.description: Upgrade. Frames are Event JSON: replay after since, then {"type":"ready","seq":N}, then live. {"type":"reset"} means the cursor is gone: drop local state and fetch GET /api/v1/notifications?state=open, keeping the connection.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Last seq the client has; replay starts after it. Default 0.

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description: Optional comma list of topics to filter to.
